name: list_macros
description: List the macros saved in the Workflows panel (id, name, description, step count).

name: get_macro
description: Read one saved macro in full, including every step and its variables.

name: create_macro
description: Save a new macro: a named sequence of MCP tool calls replayed deterministically with no LLM in the loop. Use this to turn actions you just performed into a reusable macro — list the same tool calls, in order, with the arguments you used.

name.description: Short name shown in the Workflows panel

input.description: Tool arguments. String values may contain {{var}} placeholders.

waitFor.description: CSS selector to wait for before this step runs

delay.description: Extra pause (ms) before this step runs — useful for pacing a demo

waitTimeout.description: Max ms to wait for waitFor

saveAs.description: Store this step result in the run vars under this name

vars.description: JSON object (as text) supplying values for {{var}} placeholders

name: update_macro
description: Overwrite fields of a saved macro. Passing `steps` replaces the whole list — call get_macro first, then send the edited sequence. To drop steps by position, prefer remove_macro_steps.

input.description: Tool arguments. String values may contain {{var}} placeholders.

waitFor.description: CSS selector to wait for before this step runs

delay.description: Extra pause (ms) before this step runs — useful for pacing a demo

waitTimeout.description: Max ms to wait for waitFor

saveAs.description: Store this step result in the run vars under this name

name: remove_macro_steps
description: Delete steps from a saved macro by their zero-based position, keeping the rest. Use for "drop this action from the macro". Returns the macro as it now stands.

indexes.description: Zero-based step positions to delete, as shown by get_macro

name: run_macro
description: Replay a saved macro on the active tab: its tool calls run in order and stop at the first failure. Returns each step's status and output. Use when the user asks to run a macro by name — call list_macros first to find its id.

vars.description: JSON object (as text) overriding the macro's saved {{var}} values for this run

name: cli_arm
description: Start, stop, or list a recording window of XHR and Fetch calls on the active tab. The list is request ids only and does not save a workflow. Static files are left out. Pass the ids you mean to keep to cli_compile.

action.description: start begins a window, stop ends it, list returns the calls inside it

name: cli_compile
description: Turn explicit captured request ids into one site CLI in the Workflows panel. Only those ids are included. Writes stay off. Pass extract to teach every new command which HTML fields to return. Returns the workflow id and command names, never header or body values.

requestIds.description: requestId values from list_requests or cli_arm

name.description: Name shown in the Workflows panel

site.description: Site slug. Defaults to the host

baseUrl.description: Origin to keep. Other origins are dropped

names.description: Command name per requestId, named for what it does, e.g. { "123.4": "search" }. Omit for names derived from the path

selector.description: CSS selector that matches each row

name.description: Field name, such as title or link

selector.description: CSS selector relative to the row. Omit to use the row itself

attr.description: Attribute to read, such as href. Omit to read the text

extract.description: Fields to read from an HTML response. Saved on the command.

name: cli_list
description: List saved site CLIs: id, site, command names, effects, and whether writes are on. No header values or secrets.

name: cli_describe
description: Describe one saved CLI, or one of its commands: method, path, effect, flags, session header names, saved extract, and evidence request ids. The reply ends with the cli_run object (id, command, inputs). Inputs are blank here. The Workflows panel fills them from the captured request. Cookie values are never included.

id.description: CLI id from cli_list or cli_compile

command.description: One command name. Omit to describe every command

name: cli_run
description: Run one saved CLI command inside the logged-in tab. Cookies stay in the tab. Read commands send immediately. Write and unknown commands send only when writes are on for that CLI. A failure after a write was sent returns action_outcome_unknown and is not retried. Pass extract once to teach the command which fields to read from an HTML page. Later runs use the saved extract and return those fields instead of the page. Without extract, an HTML page comes back as a short preview.

id.description: CLI id from cli_list or cli_compile

inputs.description: Flag values keyed by flag name. Required path flags must be present

selector.description: CSS selector that matches each row

name.description: Field name, such as title or link

selector.description: CSS selector relative to the row. Omit to use the row itself

attr.description: Attribute to read, such as href. Omit to read the text

extract.description: Fields to read from an HTML response. Saved on the command.

name: cli_writes
description: Turn writes on or off for one saved CLI. Ask the user once before turning writes on. This only flips the saved flag. It does not send a request.

id.description: CLI id from cli_list or cli_compile

enabled.description: true allows write and unknown commands to send

name: cli_export
description: Return a curl script for a saved CLI. Flags are placeholders. Captured secrets and cookie values are not included.

id.description: CLI id from cli_list or cli_compile
